learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and abilities to organize and manage projects; as well as to know the organizational structure and functions of a project office.

Ability to draft, sign, and develop projects in the field of industrial engineering, according to the specific corresponding technology (Electrical, Industrial Electronics, Mechanical, and Industrial Chemical), that have as their object, in accordance with the knowledge acquired as established in section 5 of Ministerial Order CIN/351/2009, the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly, or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing and automation processes.
Ability to direct the activities that are the object of the engineering projects described in the previous section.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans, and other similar tasks.
Ability to handle specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.

Knowledge, understanding, and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the profession of Industrial Technical Engineer, in the specific corresponding technology (Electrical, Industrial Electronics, Mechanical, and Industrial Chemical).

Work effectively in a group integrating abilities and knowledge to make decisions in the field of industrial engineering, in the specific corresponding technology (Electrical, Industrial Electronics, Mechanical, and Industrial Chemical).
Develop designs and projects in the field of industrial engineering, according to the specific corresponding technology (Electrical, Industrial Electronics, Mechanical, and Industrial Chemical).
Apply legislation, specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Perform measurements, calculations, studies, reports, and other similar tasks.

Adequately communicate knowledge, procedures, results, skills, and aspects of the field of Industrial Engineering, in its specific corresponding technology (Electrical, Industrial Electronics, Mechanical, and Industrial Chemical), using specific vocabulary and terminology, and appropriate means.

Organize, plan, and manage the design and development of industrial engineering projects, in its specific corresponding technology (Electrical, Industrial Electronics, Mechanical, and Industrial Chemical).

Work in multidisciplinary and multilingual environments developing the ability to make decisions in the field of industrial engineering, in its specific corresponding technology (Electrical, Industrial Electronics, Mechanical, and Industrial Chemical).

syllabus_topics: Competencies and environment of Industrial Engineering
General Project Theory and its application to engineering projects
BLOCK 3: ENGINEERING PROJECTS AND THEIR STANDARDIZED DOCUMENTATION
Generation of Engineering projects and reports.
The Technical Office and the development of Standardized Documentation
Basic knowledge and its application to computer systems.
teaching_methods: use of computer and bibliographic resources
diverse activities, generally working in groups
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, assessment is mixed. The written test (30%), teamwork (40%), and practical work (30%) must each be passed for a final course pass. For students who renounce continuous assessment, the final grade consists of a written test (80%) and a practical lab test (20%), with a minimum of 40% required in each. For the extraordinary call, the final grade is based on a Final Theory Exam (30%) and a Project (70%), with a positive evaluation required in both aspects separately.
